author: Top Gear
description:
This is, essentially, a new McLaren F1! There’s a 690hp V12 in the middle, a central driver’s seat, and it’s the work of Gordon Murray, creator of the OG Big Mac from the early 1990s. In this video, the great man himself talks Top Gear around his new three-seat supercar homage…

author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Bugatti Destrier, an ultra-exclusive, one-off hypercar. It’s essentially a luxurious and (potentially) road-legal Bugatti Bolide, and the third member of Bugatti’s bespoke coach-built Solitaire family – following the Brouillard and FKP Homage. Power comes from a 1600hp quad-turbo 8.0-litre W16 engine, and in this video Bugatti boss Mate Rimac talks Top Gear around this new one-of-one hypercar that makes the upcoming V16 Tourbillon look tame!

author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Koenigsegg CCGT1. It’s road legal, but also the fastest track-focused car Koenigsegg has ever made. Loosely based on the Koenigsegg CC850 – a hypercar that pays homage to the CC8S, Koenigsegg’s first production car – the CCGT1 is a tribute to Koenigsegg’s first and only race car project, the CCGT GT1. In this video, Christian von Koenigsegg talks Top Gear around his new 1600hp hypercar…
